fact: Design and Implement receive the active task label for retrieving the facts that govern their assignment.
For an authored creation, the plugin uses .fact/records.tsv or the explicitly supplied path. Updates, retirements and reuse resolve to the existing row.
Reusing a fact preserves its registered text and makes it available under the current task label.
An update supplies the replacement text and a deletion supplies its reason. Resolve the selected fact before altering its task view.
